# Healthcare Patient Outcome Analysis

An interactive 30-day hospital readmission analysis built with Python, SQL (SQLite), statistics and Streamlit.

**Data:** synthetic. 8,000 hospital discharges are generated by code with a fixed random seed,
so no dataset download is needed and results are reproducible. This is not real patient data.

## What it does
- SQL queries to extract cohorts (by diagnosis, follow-up, high-risk patients, window functions)
- Data cleaning in Python: duplicates removed, missing values filled with the median
- Correlation analysis and chi-square tests to find factors linked to readmission
- Logistic regression (odds ratios) to see which factors raise risk when all are considered together
- Intervention estimates: how much readmission could fall if more patients get a 7-day follow-up
  (model-based estimates, not clinical proof)
- Filters for diagnosis, age group and insurance, plus a CSV download

## Run locally
```
pip install -r requirements.txt
streamlit run app.py
```

## Files
- `app.py` the Streamlit app
- `requirements.txt` the packages Streamlit Cloud installs
- `Healthcare_Patient_Outcome_Analysis.ipynb` the full notebook version (also exports Excel and Power BI files)
